messages:
Rae (devex): Heads-up: planned SDK publish tomorrow 09:30 PT. Release touches py/ts clients, removes legacy sync. Need explicit dist-tag + rollback protocol.

Hector (sdk): Last canary showed a couple of signature warnings. We'll rotate signing key pre-publish. Recommend stagger: py first, ts second.

Mina (release): Concrete dist-tag policy? We need commands for support.

Rae (devex): Policy proposal: publish to `next` (canary) -> 24h watch -> promote to `latest` after 48h if no regressions. If dicey in first 2h, immediate rollback: set `latest` back to prior and hold releases.

Tess (docs): I'll prepare migration + pinning snippet. Please confirm pin commands.

Hector (sdk): Dist-tag commands for docs:
```
# canary
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@3.2.0 next
# promote
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@3.2.0 latest
# rollback
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdks@3.1.5 latest
```
For pip: `pip install redwood-sdk==3.1.5` to pin.

Publish Bot: preflight: canary pipeline green \u2705; sign-check: warn (old-key)

Ali (oncall): Rollback triggers: >1% install fails in 30m OR >7 direct user reports in 2h OR signature verification errors. Alert thresholds: 0.5% first 15m, 1.0% next 45m.

Mina (release): Agree. We'll also prepare a hotfix 3.2.1 flow if sign rotation fixes it quickly.

Hector (sdk): Key rotation steps I'll run in CI now and post output. Expect ~10m.

Tess (docs): Deprecation blurb: short callout + migration link. Will drop copy in this thread by EOD.

Rae (devex): Stagger schedule: py at 09:30, watch 30m, ts at 10:05. If sign-check still warns, hold ts publish.

Publish Bot: reminder scheduled: 2026-03-01T16:15:00Z preflight in 15m

Mina (release): I'll coordinate status page template so comms can go out fast if needed.

Ali (oncall): I'll add temporary alert rule and standby for manual rollback if triggered.

Hector (sdk): Ack. Posting CI key-rotation logs shortly.

Rae (devex): Everyone react :thumbsup: to ack plan. We'll proceed unless blocked. Thanks!
